summary.text: Terrain of Longevity Heaven under golden light, and four rank eight positions that hold core authority with the Eight Extremities.

claims.text: Golden light envelops the Four Desolations of Longevity Heaven.

Longevity Heaven is Giant Sun Immortal Venerable’s rank nine grotto-heaven. Four Desolations and Eight Extremities form its terrain, much like how the sovereign immortal aperture has nine heavens and five regions. Immortal Gu House Calamity Luck Altar, rank eight, stands at the heart of the Four Desolations, at the center of the Eight Extremities. Heaven Extremity urges Five Elements Grandmaster to surrender until the Four Desolation Immortals awaken, while those Immortals are still asleep and Longevity Heaven’s defense already exceeds the intruder’s expectations.

Longevity Heaven has twelve positions, separated into Eight Extremities and Four Desolations. The Four Desolation Immortals are East Desolation, South Desolation, West Desolation, and North Desolation, four rank eight immortals. Those twelve hold the core authority of Longevity Heaven and are elites among Gu Immortals, though the grotto-heaven also has other Gu Immortals. When ringing alarm bell sounds, Earth Extremity says they can only awaken the Four Desolation Immortals, and South Desolation Immortal appears in azure-gold armor, old and muscular, with a beard to his chest. The Eight Extremities greet him as Lord South Desolation and agree to follow his lead to obtain love Immortal Gu.

The Four Desolation Immortals are only meant for rank eight Gu Immortals. Bull Demon and Flower Lady take the role of North Desolation Immortal together as a duo: Bull Demon is a muscular brute with a thick beard and thunderous voice, extremely tall and strong, while Flower Lady is a little girl with a flower on her head who sits on his shoulder, giggling with crystal-like eyes. When West Desolation Immortal Bing Sai Chuan awakens, they greet him as Senior West Desolation; Bing Sai Chuan is a time path great expert from Giant Sun Immortal Venerable’s generation, and among the Four Desolation Immortals East Desolation Immortal has the highest status while Bing Sai Chuan is second.

At Longevity Heaven’s most central area, Calamity Luck Altar has the Four Desolations in its four directions, with eight areas for the Eight Extremities around them. Golden light radiates above the Four Desolations.
